# Webhook Status Display

## kumva-start-campaign Node Status

### Initial State
- Status: "Listening: /kumva/webhook" (blue dot)

### During Active Session
- Status: "Active: session_abc_123... | Listening: /kumva/webhook" (green dot)
- Shows first 12 chars of sessionId + webhook path

### On Error
- Status: "Error | Listening: /kumva/webhook" (red ring)
- Webhook path always shown

### On Session Creation Error
- Status: "Session creation failed" (red ring)

## Node Configuration Display

Open node details to see:

1. **Webhook Path** - Input field (default: /kumva/webhook)
2. **Full Webhook URL** - Read-only display
   - Updates in real-time when path changes
   - Format: KUMVA_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL + path
   - Example: https://your-domain.com/kumva/webhook

## Environment Setup

Set in .env:
```
KUMVA_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL=https://your-domain.com
```

The full URL is computed as: `KUMVA_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, '') + webhookPath`
